options.name: ✈️ Flight DXB → LHR (EK0007)
options.description: Depart Dubai 02:15 Terminal 3. Arrive London Heathrow 07:05 Terminal 3. Immigration, baggage, then Heathrow Express (15 min) or Tube (50 min) to central London. Check into hotel & freshen up.

options.name: Westminster Walk — Big Ben & Parliament
options.description: See Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, Westminster Bridge. Easy walking route along the Thames to ease into London.

options.name: Borough Market
options.description: Iconic open food market — artisan cheese, fresh pastries, street food from around the world. Great first meal in London.

options.name: South Bank Walk & Tate Modern
options.description: Walk along the Thames past the Globe Theatre to Tate Modern. Free entry, converted power station, world-class modern art.

options.name: London Eye at Sunset
options.description: 30-min ride with panoramic views of the entire city. Book ahead to skip queues. Magic at golden hour.

options.name: Dinner at Flat Iron Covent Garden
options.description: Amazing affordable steak. Casual, kid-friendly. One of London's best value restaurants.

options.name: Westminster Bridge Night Walk
options.description: See Big Ben and Parliament lit up at night. Stunning photo ops. Easy after-dinner stroll.

options.name: Leave Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Depart from Marble Arch by Thistle hotel. Located steps from Marble Arch tube station (Central Line).
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Tower of London — Crown Jewels
options.description: See the Crown Jewels, explore the medieval fortress, Beefeater tours, ravens. Book timed entry online. Arrive early to beat crowds at the Jewel House.

options.name: Buckingham Palace & Changing of the Guard
options.description: Watch the iconic ceremony (usually 11:00, check schedule). Arrive early for a good spot along the Mall.

options.name: Tower Bridge Exhibition & Borough Market Lunch
options.description: Walk the glass floor high-level walkways at Tower Bridge, then head to Borough Market for an amazing lunch. Two icons in one afternoon.

options.name: Churchill War Rooms
options.description: Underground WWII bunker museum. Fascinating history — see where Churchill directed the war effort. Amazing for all ages.
options.address: Clive Steps, King Charles St, SW1A 2AQ

options.name: Westminster Abbey
options.description: Gothic architecture, royal tombs, coronation church. Poets' Corner, Tomb of the Unknown Warrior. Audio guide included.

options.name: West End Musical — The Lion King
options.description: Spectacular puppetry and music at the Lyceum Theatre. Perfect for the whole family. Book in advance!

options.name: West End Musical — Wicked
options.description: The untold story of the witches of Oz. Stunning sets and vocals at the Apollo Victoria Theatre.
options.address: Apollo Victoria Theatre, 17 Wilton Rd, SW1V 1LG

options.name: West End Musical — Hamilton
options.description: The hip-hop musical phenomenon. Your 13yo will love the energy. Victoria Palace Theatre.
options.address: Victoria Palace Theatre, Victoria St, SW1E 5EA

options.name: Return to Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Head back to the hotel for the night. Marble Arch tube station is on the Central Line.
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Leave Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Depart from Marble Arch by Thistle hotel. Located steps from Marble Arch tube station (Central Line).
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Natural History Museum
options.description: Free entry. Dinosaur gallery, blue whale skeleton, earthquake simulator, wildlife garden. Incredible building alone is worth the visit.

options.name: Science Museum
options.description: Free entry. Interactive galleries, IMAX theatre, space exploration, computing history. Wonderlab is hands-on fun for teens.

options.name: Imperial War Museum
options.description: Free entry. WWI & WWII exhibits, Holocaust gallery, tanks and aircraft. Powerful and educational.

options.name: Portobello Road Market (Sunday)
options.description: Famous open-air market in Notting Hill. Antiques, vintage clothes, street food, colourful houses. Quieter on Sundays but shops are open.

transport_to_next.line: Central Line from Notting Hill Gate

options.name: British Museum
options.description: Free entry. Rosetta Stone, Egyptian mummies, Parthenon sculptures, Aztec treasures. One of the world's greatest history museums.

options.name: Greenwich Market & Cutty Sark
options.description: Covered artisan market + step aboard the famous tea clipper. Scenic area with Royal Observatory nearby.

options.name: Covent Garden Street Performers & Dinner
options.description: Watch street magicians, musicians, and acrobats. Browse boutiques, then pick from dozens of restaurants.

options.name: Dishoom King's Cross
options.description: Bombay-inspired restaurant — legendary black daal, lamb chops, naan. Book ahead, always packed. The whole family will love it.

options.name: Evening at Southbank Centre
options.description: Free foyer events, street food market, riverside atmosphere. Check what's on — often live music or film screenings.

options.name: Return to Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Head back to the hotel for the night. Marble Arch tube station is on the Central Line.
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Leave Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Depart from Marble Arch by Thistle hotel. Located steps from Marble Arch tube station (Central Line).
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Warner Bros Studio Tour — Harry Potter
options.description: The Making of Harry Potter — original sets, props, costumes, Diagon Alley, Hogwarts Great Hall. Book months ahead! Shuttle bus from Watford Junction.

transport_to_next.line: Shuttle to Watford Junction → Metropolitan/Overground to London

options.name: Camden Market & Camden Lock
options.description: Massive open market — street food from 30+ countries, vintage clothes, music memorabilia, alternative fashion. Your son will love it.

options.name: Platform 9¾ at King's Cross + Coal Drops Yard
options.description: Photo at the Harry Potter platform, shop for HP merch. Then explore the stunning Coal Drops Yard — design shops and restaurants.

options.name: Madame Tussauds
options.description: Wax figures of celebrities, Marvel zone, Star Wars experience, sports legends. Fun for teens.

options.name: Camden Street Food Dinner
options.description: KERB street food collective with global cuisines — Korean BBQ, Mexican, Lebanese. Casual, fun atmosphere by the canal.

options.name: Primrose Hill Sunset
options.description: One of the best sunset views over the entire London skyline. Short walk from Camden. Bring snacks and enjoy.

options.name: Chinatown & Leicester Square
options.description: Vibrant dinner in Chinatown — try Barshu for Sichuan or Wong Kei for classic. Then explore Leicester Square's lights.

options.name: Return to Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Head back to the hotel for the night. Marble Arch tube station is on the Central Line.
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Leave Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Depart from Marble Arch by Thistle hotel. Located steps from Marble Arch tube station (Central Line).
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Wembley Stadium Tour
options.description: Go behind the scenes — walk through the players' tunnel, sit in the dugout, see the Royal Box, hold a replica trophy. 75 min guided tour.

options.name: Tottenham Hotspur Stadium Tour
options.description: Ultra-modern stadium — includes the Dare Skywalk on the roof! Walk the pitch, see changing rooms, press room. One of Europe's best stadiums.

options.name: Go-Karting — TeamSport Bermondsey
options.description: Indoor go-karting on a multi-level track. Speeds up to 40mph. Min age 8, so your son is good to go! Adrenaline rush for the whole family.

options.name: Go-Karting — Capital Karts
options.description: London's longest indoor karting track. Race against each other on 1km circuit. Arrive & Drive sessions available.

options.name: Emirates Stadium Tour (Arsenal)
options.description: Self-guided tour of Arsenal's home. Dressing rooms, tunnel, pitchside, museum with trophies. Perfect add-on for football fans.

options.name: Football Match (Check Schedule!)
options.description: Late June may have international friendlies, pre-season, or community matches. Check FA, Premier League, and club sites closer to date for fixtures.

options.name: Sports Bar — The Faltering Fullback
options.description: Legendary sports pub in Finsbury Park with massive beer garden. Watch any live match on multiple screens.

options.name: Dinner at The Ivy Tower Bridge
options.description: Elegant brasserie with Tower Bridge views. British classics with a modern twist. Kid-friendly menu available.

options.name: Return to Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Head back to the hotel for the night. Marble Arch tube station is on the Central Line.
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Leave Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Depart from Marble Arch by Thistle hotel. Located steps from Marble Arch tube station (Central Line).
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Harrods
options.description: The world's most famous department store. Explore the legendary Food Halls, fashion floors, and Egyptian escalator. Don't miss the perfumery.

transport_to_next.duration: 10 min to Sloane St / Harvey Nichols

options.name: Selfridges Oxford Street
options.description: Iconic department store with cutting-edge fashion. Great designer brands, beauty hall, and rooftop events in summer.

options.name: Bond Street & Burlington Arcade — Luxury Watch Shopping
options.description: New Bond Street is London's luxury mile. Rolex, Omega, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet at Watches of Switzerland and boutiques. Burlington Arcade for classic British luxury.
options.address: New Bond St & Burlington Arcade, W1S

options.name: Designer Shopping — Sloane Street & Harvey Nichols
options.description: Sloane Street has Chanel, Dior, Valentino, Gucci all in a row. Harvey Nichols for multi-brand luxury. Perfect for Michel and wife.

options.name: Mount Street & Mayfair Boutiques
options.description: Quiet luxury strip — Balenciaga, Celine, Lanvin, plus independent jewellers. More relaxed than Bond Street.

options.name: Son's Streetwear Run — Trapstar, Palm Angels, Corteiz
options.description: Trapstar flagship on Portobello Rd, Palm Angels at Selfridges/Flannels, Corteiz (check for drops/pop-ups). Also hit Dover Street Market for cutting-edge brands.
options.address: Soho / Oxford St / Portobello Rd area

transport_to_next.duration: Within walking distance in Soho/West End

options.name: Carnaby Street & Dinner in Soho
options.description: Browse Carnaby Street's indie shops, then dinner in Soho — try Bao for Taiwanese buns or Hoppers for Sri Lankan.

options.name: Dinner at Hakkasan Mayfair
options.description: Michelin-starred modern Chinese. Incredible dim sum and Peking duck. Celebrate the shopping day in style.

options.name: Return to Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Head back to the hotel for the night. Marble Arch tube station is on the Central Line.
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

days.label: Day 7 — Thursday
days.theme: Hyde Park, West End Tour & Farewell

options.name: Leave Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Depart from Marble Arch by Thistle hotel. Located steps from Marble Arch tube station (Central Line).
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Hyde Park & Serpentine Lake Boating
options.description: Rent pedal boats or rowing boats on the Serpentine. Walk through the Italian Gardens, see the Peter Pan statue, Diana Memorial Fountain.

options.name: Kensington Palace & Gardens
options.description: Princess Diana's former home. Royal fashion exhibition, beautiful sunken garden. Combined with a Kensington Gardens stroll.

options.name: West End Backstage Tour — Theatre Royal Drury Lane
options.description: Go behind the scenes of London's oldest theatre (1663). See backstage machinery, costume workshops, the Royal Box, and hear ghost stories. Guided tour.

options.name: The View from The Shard
options.description: Western Europe's tallest building. 360° views from floor 72. On a clear day you can see 40 miles. Book online for discounts.

options.name: Sky Garden (Free Rooftop Views)
options.description: Free entry (book ahead). Tropical garden at the top of the Walkie-Talkie building. 360° views, cafe inside.

options.name: Farewell Dinner at Sketch (The Gallery)
options.description: Instagrammable pink restaurant in Mayfair. Afternoon tea or dinner — a memorable last night splurge. The egg-shaped toilets are famous!

options.name: Farewell Dinner at The Ledbury
options.description: Two Michelin stars in Notting Hill. Modern British fine dining. A truly special last-night experience.

options.name: Trafalgar Square to Piccadilly Night Walk
options.description: Final evening stroll through London's heart. Nelson's Column, fountains, Piccadilly lights. Last family photos!

options.name: Return to Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Head back to the hotel for the night. Marble Arch tube station is on the Central Line.
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Leave Hotel — Marble Arch by Thistle
options.description: Depart from Marble Arch by Thistle hotel. Located steps from Marble Arch tube station (Central Line).
options.address: Bryanston St, Marble Arch, London W1H 7EH

options.name: Brick Lane Market & Street Art
options.description: East London's coolest open market. Vintage finds, street art, the famous Beigel Bake bagels. Great for last-minute unique souvenirs.

options.name: Last-minute Shopping — Regent Street & Hamleys
options.description: Pick up final souvenirs on Regent Street. Hamleys toy store (7 floors!) is a must for one last family stop.

options.name: Notting Hill Colourful Houses Walk
options.description: Pastel-coloured houses, the bookshop from the movie, quiet leafy streets. A relaxed last morning.

options.name: Spitalfields Market & Lunch
options.description: Trendy covered market in East London. Fashion, artisan food, vintage. Great last lunch spot.

options.name: Little Venice Canal Walk
options.description: Pretty canal boats near Paddington. Peaceful last London memory before heading to the airport.

options.name: Relax & Pack at Hotel
options.description: Take it easy. Pack up, rest before the overnight flight. Maybe a last coffee at a nearby cafe.

options.name: Early Dinner & Head to Heathrow ✈️
options.description: Grab a final dinner near the hotel or at Heathrow Terminal 3. Flight EK0006 departs 22:15 to Dubai (arrives 08:50+1). Be at airport by 19:30.
